Metadata.Goal: 让 Domain Operation failure response 对未建立的 request/execution facts 使用显式 unavailable 语义。
Metadata.Description: 以 contract-owned request fact projector 和 nullable response fields 消除 runtime malformed-response 默认值，同时保持合法 response 兼容。

TaskSpace.name: align-domain-operation-response-facts
TaskSpace.Description: 先锁定 unavailable/partial/full fact contract，再实现最小 type/helper correction 并做公共兼容验收。

TaskGroup.name: Response fact contract
TaskGroup.Description: 用 tests-first 固定 parse-failure fact availability、partial projection 和 admitted response compatibility。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: request fact projector 与 nullable failure response focused tests 通过
合法 response fixtures 保持 non-null facts

Task.name: 编写 unavailable 与 partial request facts 红测
Task.Description: 为完整、部分和只有 apiVersion 的 unknown input 添加 projector tests；添加 null context/ref/requested/tree failure response roundtrip，并保持现有成功 response fixtures。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 测试覆盖 full/partial/absent request facts 且独立验证每个字段
测试覆盖 pre-admission failure response 的四个 null facts 与 JSON roundtrip
测试仅因 projector/nullable contract 尚不存在而按预期 RED

Task.name: 实现 request fact projector 与 nullable response fields
Task.Description: 新增纯 projector 并拓宽 context、operationRef、requested atomicity、operationTree；保持 exact parser、valid response 和其他 DTO 不变。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: projector 对每个 fact 独立验证且不产生默认值
nullable fields 可表达 pre-admission failure，valid response 保持原值
focused request/response tests 与 declaration build 通过

TaskGroup.name: Compatibility and direction verification
TaskGroup.Description: 验证公共 export、完整 contract suites、root build 和 owner boundary。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: bun run --filter depa-data-domain-operation-contracts build 通过

Task.name: 运行 public compatibility 与 boundary 验证
Task.Description: 运行全部 contract tests、strict declaration build、root build、export/type spot-check、dependency/import guard、Codument strict 和 capsule baseline；记录 compatibility evidence。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 全部 contract suites 与 root build 通过
public projector/type declarations 可从 package root 消费
无 runtime/transport/database dependency，capsule 未修改

cdt:AttractorCheck.note: Fresh rerun confirmed exact plain-context projection, parser rejection, nullable response compatibility, owner boundaries, builds, and capsule baselines; report: reports/attractor-check-report.md.
